reference: C/A/M automatic labels and independent human labels are analyzed separately; unknown is never imputed
acceptance: score >= checker-specific D1 calibration threshold, unchanged across defenses

rq1: Spearman association of D1 score with reference acceptability
rq2: joint harmful-and-accepted rate per valid attack
mean and sample SD across three runs

uncertainty.resampling_unit: project clusters; preserve all paired task/review conditions within each sampled project
uncertainty.interval: percentile, report number of valid replicates when a class is absent
uncertainty.small_cluster_fallback: if fewer than 5 distinct projects, report task-cluster intervals as a sensitivity analysis and explicitly flag limited project coverage

hypothesis_tests.method: two-sided paired cluster sign-flip/permutation; exact enumeration when feasible, otherwise 10000 deterministic Monte Carlo draws with plus-one correction
hypothesis_tests.multiplicity: BH-FDR at 0.05 within each prespecified family

families.fixed_python: 3 within-checker D5-D1 contrasts and 3 pairwise checker contrasts at each of D1 and D5, for FPR and FNR (18 tests)
families.adaptive_python: 3 pairwise defense contrasts x 2 target checkers x 3 attack strategies for joint harmful-and-accepted rate (18 tests)
families.java: D5-D1 on the same reviews: FPR and FNR (2 tests)

missingness: Report requested, generated, parsed, labeled, and paired usable counts. No favorable replacement. Exclude unknown from labeled denominators; report unknown and call/parse failures separately. Sensitivity bounds assign all unavailable attack outcomes to failure/success extremes.
repetitions: Three attack-generation runs; D4 includes three independently optimized trajectories. Benign text is generated once, so reuse never increases its independent sample count.
human_sample: 40 Python tasks and 20 seeded Java tasks, four reviews per task. Blind selection balances benign writer and attack target/defense/run without reading scores. Preserve inclusion probabilities and independent annotations; adjudication follows initial agreement analysis.
interpretation: Fixed-text comparisons isolate the supplied information contrast. Adaptive comparisons also change attack text and estimate the full defense protocol. No raw w-minus-g construct subtraction; no equivalence claim from a nonsignificant result. No claim of D4 convergence after the fixed four-round budget.
